scope: Canonical resolution of Full Power Energy Blast Volley source conflict

records.name: Full Power Energy Blast Volley
records.decision: Canonical record corrected to Ultimate / Ki Blast / 300 Ki / starting move. Current Xenoverse 2-specific skill page and Ultimate Attack taxonomy agree, and independent Dragon Ball Wiki corroborates that it is a common Ultimate and the Future Warrior's default Ultimate.
records.mechanics_boundary: The canonical record preserves the barrage/tracking behavior but does not promote source-reported damage percentages as patch-independent facts.

policy: Canonical skills.json remains authoritative. Historical conflicting research batch 253 remains intact as provenance; it is not deleted or treated as current truth.
